content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident opened: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for Private VPC tenants in us-west-2. Paging on-call.
pagerduty: Paging oncall_ryan — P1 alert: inference-gateway 5xx spike for private traffic.
oncall_ryan: I'm on it. What's the initial scope and symptom?
sre_maya: Seeing 504/502s from the private inference gateway cluster. Spike began ~09:12 UTC. Metrics: private tenant 5xx rate jumped to ~18% for a few subnets. Hosted API unaffected.
netops_julie: I can see a pattern at the NAT/transit layer: translation table churn and many short-lived SNAT mappings being created.
eng-runtime-sam: Runtime logs show a lot of upstream connection resets and lots of sockets in TIME_WAIT. Example curl from inside a customer subnet:
```
$ curl -v https://inference-gw.private.example/health
* Connected to 10.10.2.1:443
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```
sre_maya: tcpdump on the gateway shows repeated SYNs from the same ephemeral port being mapped/reused across different upstream IPs — looks like translation collisions or ephemeral pool exhaustion.
netops_julie: Hypothesis: ephemeral port exhaustion on the transit NAT causing rapid SNAT map churn and asymmetric translations -> upstream resets -> gateway 504s.
support_ash: Impacted customers discovered so far: tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-f. Severity: degraded success rate for private calls. Some retries amplify the problem.
pm_lena: Need ETA for mitigation and what we tell customers.
oncall_ryan: Short-term mitigations being executed: 1) expand ephemeral port range on transit NAT from 32768-60999 -> 32768-65535, 2) enable port-preserving SNAT hashing where supported, 3) temporarily reroute affected private subnets through spare NAT instance in the same AZ.
netops_julie: Applying ephemeral-range change to NAT cluster us-west-2-cluster-3 now (rolling config). Also adding a quick ACL tweak to ensure return traffic isn't dropped if translation flips.
eng-runtime-sam: Recommend we also throttle aggressive client retries at the gateway to reduce storming. Pushing a canary route config to limit retries:
```
routes:
  - match: /v1/*
    retry_policy:
      max_retries: 2
      per_try_timeout_ms: 2000
```
sre_maya: After the first NAT range expansion at 09:27 UTC the 5xx rate dropped from ~18% -> ~7%. After rerouting impacted subnets to the spare NAT at 09:33 UTC errors dropped to ~1.5%.
support_ash: Drafting customer comms now: "We observed transient gateway timeouts caused by private network translation pressure; mitigation is in place; we will follow up with a full RCA and timeline." :email:
pm_lena: Assign RCA owners: netops_julie + eng-runtime-sam. Long-term options: add NAT capacity, port-preserving SNAT, connection affinity, or offer Dedicated NAT for high-throughput tenants.
oncall_ryan: Handoff: I'm staying on until 10:30 UTC then handing off monitoring to SRE. Current state: mitigated, monitoring.
sre_maya: I'll own post-mitigation monitoring and collect packet captures/metrics for RCA. Saving pcaps and netstat dumps.
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated (monitoring). Duration so far: ~21m. Severity downgraded.
support_ash: Customer notifications sent at 09:45 UTC to affected tenants. No escalations received.
netops_julie: Notes for RCA: observed 3x increase in short-lived outbound connections from containerized inference clients after a client library change yesterday that made pooling more aggressive. Correlating timestamps now.
eng-runtime-sam: We'll change default pooling back and add exponential backoff to reduce connection churn in the short term; plan a config flag for high-throughput tenants.
pm_lena: Schedule postmortem: tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Include netops, runtime, SRE, and support.
sre_maya: Artifacts saved to s3://redwood-incident/3165001234/ (pcap, netstat, graphs). Will attach link in postmortem.
oncall_ryan: Thanks team — nice work on the quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
